# AI & Japan Tax Cost Atlas 2026

> Static programmatic SEO (pSEO) atlas of deterministic, zero-tracking interactive calculators covering 2026 LLM API pricing comparisons and 2026-2027 Japanese freelance income tax, Furusato Nozei safe ceilings, Oct 2026 Invoice 50% cliff, and incorporation break-even simulations.

- Canonical Hub: https://pecopeko.github.io/ai-tax-cost-atlas/
- Sitemap: https://pecopeko.github.io/ai-tax-cost-atlas/sitemap.xml
- Pricing Snapshot Date: 2026-11-20
- Total Static Pages: 152

## Cluster A — 2026 LLM API Pricing & Cost Matrix (88 Calculators)

- Cluster A Directory: https://pecopeko.github.io/ai-tax-cost-atlas/llm/index.html
- Models Covered: GPT-5, GPT-4.1, o4-mini, Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Opus 4, Claude Haiku 3.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, Qwen3 235B (OpenRouter), Llama 4 Maverick (OpenRouter)
- Methodology: Exact standard, cached-input (75%-90% discount), 50% async Batch API, and Japanese CJK tokenizer inflation (1.55x-2.10x) calculations in USD and JPY.

## Cluster B — 2026-2027 Japan Freelance Tax, Furusato & Incorporation (61 Calculators)

- Cluster B Directory: https://pecopeko.github.io/ai-tax-cost-atlas/jp-tax/index.html
- Statutory Basis: 7-bracket progressive income tax (5%-45%) + 2.1% reconstruction tax, 10% resident tax + JPY 5,000 per-capita, Blue Return 650k deduction, Basic Deduction step-down above JPY 24M, Individual Business Tax (5% over JPY 2.9M), Tokyo 23-ward NHI caps, Furusato Nozei 95% safe ceiling, Oct 2026 Invoice 50% buyer-side cliff, and incorporation break-even (baseline break-even: 648.0万円).
